globetrotter.brief: Jugá en todos los países que puedas, ganando en el camino.

national_hero.title: Héroe de la selección
national_hero.brief: Construí una carrera internacional de peso.

iron_man.title: Hombre de hierro
iron_man.brief: Entrá a la cancha la mayor cantidad de veces posible.

no_loans.title: Sin atajos
no_loans.brief: Llegá a lo más alto sin aceptar nunca un préstamo.

resilient.title: Piel dura
resilient.brief: Llegá lejos y vale más todavía si el camino fue accidentado.

beloved.title: Amado por la hinchada
beloved.brief: Terminá la carrera con la tribuna de tu lado.

marquee_number.title: Camiseta pesada
marquee_number.brief: Pasá la mayor cantidad de temporadas con un número de peso.

journeyman.title: Mercenario
journeyman.brief: Rodá por muchos clubes y ganá en todos los que puedas.

homecoming.title: Vuelta a casa
homecoming.brief: Construí historia en el club que te formó y volvé para cerrar ahí.

sharpshooter.title: Temporada mágica
sharpshooter.brief: Hacé la mejor temporada goleadora que puedas.

youth_to_star.title: De cero a la cima
youth_to_star.brief: Evolucioná lo máximo posible desde los 50 de overall.

unbreakable.title: Irrompible
unbreakable.brief: Llegá alto sin lesión grave y sin descender nunca.

individual_glory.title: Gloria individual
individual_glory.brief: Perseguí los premios: goleador y Balón de Oro.

double_legend.title: Leyenda doble
double_legend.brief: Volvete ídolo o leyenda en más de un club.

loyal_servant.title: Servidor fiel
loyal_servant.brief: Hacé el paso más largo posible por un solo club.

clean_sheet_wall.title: Muralla
clean_sheet_wall.brief: Acumulá la mayor cantidad de partidos sin recibir goles.

riser.title: De la B a la élite
riser.brief: Ascendé de categoría y demostrá que no fue suerte.

domestic_dominance.title: Dueño del país
domestic_dominance.brief: Llená la vitrina con títulos nacionales.

world_class.title: Nivel mundial
world_class.brief: Llegá al mayor overall que puedas.

veteran.title: Veterano
veteran.brief: Seguí siendo bueno a una edad en la que casi todos ya pararon.

complete_career.title: Carrera completa
complete_career.brief: Un poco de todo: títulos, selección, estatus de leyenda y nivel.

poacher.title: Killer del área
poacher.brief: No es el total, es el promedio: goles por partido por encima de todo.

creator_in_chief.title: Temporada de asistidor
creator_in_chief.brief: Hacé la mejor temporada de asistencias que puedas.

treble_winner.title: Liga, copa y continente
treble_winner.brief: Ganá en los tres frentes. La continental vale más.

world_conqueror.title: Campeón del mundo
world_conqueror.brief: Andá por los títulos mundiales, de club o de selección.

kept_the_shirt.title: Dos direcciones
kept_the_shirt.brief: Como mucho dos clubes en toda la carrera, y historia en ambos.

cap_century.title: Centenario
cap_century.brief: Acumulá la mayor cantidad de partidos con la selección.

international_scorer.title: Goleador de la selección
international_scorer.brief: Hacé goles con la camiseta de tu país.

early_call.title: Llamado temprano
early_call.brief: Que te convoquen lo más joven posible, y sostenelo.

ever_present.title: Siempre en cancha
ever_present.brief: Sumá temporadas de titular de verdad, partido tras partido.

second_tier_hero.title: Héroe del ascenso
second_tier_hero.brief: Construí la carrera en el ascenso y llevá al club arriba.

cult_hero.title: Querido donde va
cult_hero.brief: Volvete ídolo en varios clubes, no solo en uno.

golden_boot_run.title: Bota de oro
golden_boot_run.brief: Andá por los goleos y por la mejor temporada de goles.

decorated.title: Estante de premios
decorated.brief: Juntá premios individuales, con el Balón de Oro valiendo más.

safe_hands.title: Muralla
safe_hands.brief: Llegá alto de nivel y hacé la mejor temporada con la valla invicta.

challenge.bestTwoRule: Tres objetivos, solo cuentan los dos mejores. Uno vas a tener que abandonarlo.
challenge.hiddenBriefNote: Se revela a los {age}. Hasta entonces juegas sin saber qué te va a pedir.
challenge.bankRule: A partir de los {age} puedes retirarte cuando quieras. Cada temporada muy por debajo de tu pico resta puntos, sabe cuándo parar.
challenge.twilightHint: Jugaste demasiado tiempo después de tu pico.
challenge.peakHint: El mejor overall que alcanzaste también suma puntos. Llegar a 99 vale el máximo.

no_early_moves.title: Sin salir antes de los 24
no_early_moves.brief: Ningún traspaso definitivo antes de los 24. Construye algo donde empezaste.

two_clubs_max.title: Dos clubes como máximo
two_clubs_max.brief: Toda la carrera en dos clubes, no más. Elige bien el segundo.

no_giants.title: Nada de gigantes
no_giants.brief: Prohibido vestir la camiseta de un club grande. Lo que ganes, gánalo donde nadie lo esperaba.

one_country.title: Nunca salir del país
one_country.brief: Naces, juegas y te retiras en el mismo país. Sin Europa, sin atajos.

top_flight_only.title: Solo primera división
top_flight_only.brief: Ni una temporada en segunda. Ni una.

no_loans.title: Sin cesiones
no_loans.brief: Rechaza toda cesión. Si no hay sitio para ti, resuélvelo de otra forma.

never_settle.title: Nunca echar raíces
never_settle.brief: Cuatro temporadas seguidas en un club como máximo. Ningún sitio llega a ser casa.

no_marquee_number.title: Sin dorsal histórico
no_marquee_number.brief: Nunca aceptes un número del 1 al 11. Sin focos, solo trabajo.

never_relegated.title: Jamás descendido
never_relegated.brief: Un descenso y la regla del día está rota.

exile.title: Exilio
exile.brief: Juega en al menos tres países distintos. Ningún lugar es definitivo.

nav.leaveDescription: La carrera en curso se perderá. Esto no se puede deshacer.
nav.giveUpDescription: Tu carrera termina acá y vas directo al resumen. Todo lo que ganaste sigue contando, pero no se puede volver a jugar.

positiveOutcome.description: You feel great in the new boots

negativeOutcome.description: It takes a while to get used to them

ignore_the_boos.label: Ignore the boos
ignore_the_boos.outcome: You carry on regardless, nothing changes

negativeOutcome.description: It backfires and gets used against you

rival_milestone.title: Your rival makes headlines
rival_milestone.description: {rivalName} just achieved something big, and everyone wants your reaction.

positiveOutcome.description: It becomes pure fuel for your training

negativeOutcome.description: The comparison weighs more than it helps

shrug_it_off.label: Shrug it off
shrug_it_off.outcome: You keep to your own path, unbothered

rival_duel.title: Head-to-head
rival_duel.description: You and {rivalName} are fighting for the same headlines this season.

positiveOutcome.description: You show up in the decisive moments

negativeOutcome.description: The pressure of deciding it all alone weighs on you

let_the_team_carry_it.label: Let the team carry it
let_the_team_carry_it.outcome: Less spotlight on you, more chances for the team

captain_armband.title: The captain's armband
captain_armband.description: The squad votes and the coach wants to hand you the captain's armband from now on.

positiveOutcome.description: You wear the responsibility like a glove

negativeOutcome.description: The extra weight of it hurts more than it helps

pass_it.label: Decline, for now
pass_it.outcome: You'd rather focus on just your own game

iconic_number.title: The club's iconic shirt number
iconic_number.description: The board offers you the number that carries the weight of the club's history.

positiveOutcome.description: You honour the shirt and the fans idolise you even more

negativeOutcome.description: Plenty think you haven't earned it yet

let_someone_else.label: Let another player have it
let_someone_else.outcome: You'd rather not carry that weight right now

locker_room_clash.title: Dressing-room friction
locker_room_clash.description: A younger teammate challenges your standing in front of the group, and everyone's watching how you react.

positiveOutcome.description: The group recognises your authority

negativeOutcome.description: It backfires and creates more friction

keep_the_peace.label: Keep the peace in the group
keep_the_peace.outcome: You choose not to feed the tension

keep_current.outcome: You'd rather not touch what's already yours

shirt_legend_tribute.description: After everything you've built here, the board opens up the whole squad list and lets you name the number you want.

take_number.label: Choose the {number}
take_number.outcome: The {number} becomes yours by the club's own decision

keep_current.label: Keep the one you know
keep_current.outcome: You're grateful, but your number already says it all

severe_injury.title: A serious injury

fight_back.outcome: You'll play again, but your career's ceiling will never be what it was

dressing_room_fallout.title: Fallout at the club

board.description: You said what you thought of the board in public. They did not wear it: immediate termination.

supporters.description: The trouble with the ultras got out of hand. The club takes you out of the squad to protect everyone and that stand does not forget.

one_club_legend.title: One club only
one_club_legend.brief: Build it all where you started. No permanent transfer.

goal_machine.title: Goal machine
goal_machine.brief: Score as many career goals as you can.

playmaker.title: The provider
playmaker.brief: Serve the team: assists above all.

trophy_hoarder.title: Trophy hoarder
trophy_hoarder.brief: Lift as many trophies as you can.

collector.title: Varied cabinet
collector.brief: Win different kinds of trophy, not the same one repeatedly.

prodigy.title: Prodigy
prodigy.brief: Get as high as possible before turning 22.

late_bloomer.title: Late bloomer
late_bloomer.brief: Still be climbing when everyone else has levelled off.

underdog_idol.title: Unlikely idol
underdog_idol.brief: Become a name at a small club, the smaller the badge, the more it counts.

globetrotter.title: Globetrotter
globetrotter.brief: Play in as many countries as you can, winning on the way.

national_hero.title: National hero
national_hero.brief: Build an international career that matters.

iron_man.title: Iron man
iron_man.brief: Take the field as many times as possible.

no_loans.title: No shortcuts
no_loans.brief: Reach the top without ever accepting a loan.

resilient.title: Thick skin
resilient.brief: Get far and it counts for more if the road was rough.

beloved.title: Loved by the crowd
beloved.brief: Finish your career with the stands on your side.

marquee_number.title: The big shirt
marquee_number.brief: Spend as many seasons as you can wearing a marquee number.

journeyman.title: Journeyman
journeyman.brief: Move through many clubs and win wherever you can.

homecoming.title: Homecoming
homecoming.brief: Build history at the club that raised you and go back to finish there.

sharpshooter.title: Magic season
sharpshooter.brief: Produce the best scoring season you can.

youth_to_star.title: Zero to the top
youth_to_star.brief: Improve as much as possible from an overall of 50.

unbreakable.title: Unbreakable
unbreakable.brief: Reach the top with no serious injury and never relegated.

individual_glory.title: Individual glory
individual_glory.brief: Chase the awards: golden boots and the Ballon d'Or.

double_legend.title: Double legend
double_legend.brief: Become an idol or legend at more than one club.

loyal_servant.title: Loyal servant
loyal_servant.brief: Make the longest single spell at one club that you can.

clean_sheet_wall.title: The wall
clean_sheet_wall.brief: Rack up as many clean sheets as possible.

riser.title: Second tier to elite
riser.brief: Win promotion and prove it wasn't a fluke.

domestic_dominance.title: Own the country
domestic_dominance.brief: Fill the cabinet with domestic titles.

world_class.title: World class
world_class.brief: Reach the highest overall you can.

veteran.title: Veteran
veteran.brief: Still be good at an age where almost everyone has stopped.

complete_career.title: Complete career
complete_career.brief: A bit of everything: trophies, caps, legend status and level.

poacher.title: Penalty-box poacher
poacher.brief: Not the tally, the rate: goals per game above everything else.

creator_in_chief.title: A season of assists
creator_in_chief.brief: Put together the best single assist season you can.

treble_winner.title: League, cup and continent
treble_winner.brief: Win on all three fronts. The continental counts most.

world_conqueror.title: Champion of the world
world_conqueror.brief: Go after the world titles, club or country.

kept_the_shirt.title: Two addresses
kept_the_shirt.brief: Two clubs at most in a whole career, and a story at both.

cap_century.title: Centurion
cap_century.brief: Pile up as many caps as you can.

international_scorer.title: Scoring for your country
international_scorer.brief: Put the goals away in the national shirt.

early_call.title: Called up young
early_call.brief: Get the call as early as you can, then keep the place.

ever_present.title: Never off the teamsheet
ever_present.brief: Stack up seasons of being a genuine starter, game after game.

second_tier_hero.title: Hero of the second tier
second_tier_hero.brief: Build the career a division down, and take the club up.

cult_hero.title: Loved wherever you go
cult_hero.brief: Become an idol at several clubs, not just one.

golden_boot_run.title: Golden Boot
golden_boot_run.brief: Chase the scoring awards and the best goal season you can.

decorated.title: A shelf of awards
decorated.brief: Collect individual honours, with the Ballon d'Or worth most.

safe_hands.title: A wall in goal
safe_hands.brief: Get your level high and put together the best shut-out season you can.

challenge.bestTwoRule: Three briefs, only the best two count. One of them has to be given up.
challenge.hiddenBriefNote: Revealed at {age}. Until then you play without knowing what it will ask for.
challenge.bankRule: From {age} you may end the career whenever you like. Every season played well below your peak costs points, know when to stop.
challenge.twilightHint: You played on too long after your peak.
challenge.peakHint: The best overall you reached is worth points too. Hitting 99 is worth the maximum.

no_early_moves.title: No moves before 24
no_early_moves.brief: No permanent transfer before your 24th birthday. Build something where you started.

two_clubs_max.title: Two clubs, maximum
two_clubs_max.brief: A whole career at no more than two clubs. Choose the second one well.

no_giants.title: No giants
no_giants.brief: Never sign for a big club. Whatever you win, win it where nobody expected it.

one_country.title: Never leave home
one_country.brief: Born, played and retired in the same country. No Europe, no shortcut.

top_flight_only.title: Top flight only
top_flight_only.brief: Not one season in the second tier. Not one.

no_loans.title: No loans
no_loans.brief: Turn down every loan. If there is no room for you, solve it another way.

never_settle.title: Never put down roots
never_settle.brief: Four consecutive seasons at one club, maximum. Nowhere ever becomes home.

no_marquee_number.title: No marquee shirt
no_marquee_number.brief: Never take a number from 1 to 11. No spotlight, just work.

never_relegated.title: Never relegated
never_relegated.brief: One relegation and the day's rule is broken.

exile.title: Exile
exile.brief: Play in at least three different countries. Nowhere is permanent.

nav.leaveDescription: The career in progress will be lost. This cannot be undone.
